title: They didn't take 18%. They took the guest.
styleLine: Kymbo scene photography for FYM (hotel) — see profiles/kymbo/build/prompts/VISUAL.md. World: a specific corner of a real modern boutique hotel. Walls are off-white/warm-cream plaster (#EDEAE4-adjacent, but NEVER pastel, NEVER teal, NEVER sage), or actual textured stone. Floor is dark oak or specific stone — NEVER jute, NEVER sisal. Walnut wood, brass or matte-black fixtures (NEVER gold, NEVER champagne). Real hotel objects with visible use: linen bedding with natural wrinkles (NOT perfectly ironed), leather-bound guest register with cracked binding, brass room key with a leather tag, folded newspaper (non-readable), a MATURE OLIVE TREE or LEMON TREE in a terracotta planter (NEVER a succulent, NEVER a fiddle-leaf, NEVER in a round white pot). Palette: warm-neutral but restrained — a real expensive hotel that is SPECIFIC, not decorated. Modern rollerball pens only (NEVER fountain pens, NEVER quills). Documentary, unposed — Apartamento or The Gentlewoman feel, NOT resort brochure stock, NOT dated grand-hotel cliché. 35mm color negative, ONE dominant morning warm-cool side-window key (~8am), clear light side, deep near-black shadow side. Composition: off-center, asymmetric weight, one object cropped by the frame edge. UNIVERSALLY PROHIBITED: succulents, round white ceramic pots, fiddle-leaf figs, monstera, jute or sisal rugs, terrazzo or marble slabs, perfectly stacked photogenic books, fresh-cut flowers in clear glass vases, motivational wall art, pastel walls (teal/sage/blush cast), symmetric three-object triangles, centered composition, soft even daylight, blown-out backlit windows, dated hotel props (key racks, service bells, fountain pens, paper ledgers, cash boxes, welcome-mat signs). 4:5 native (1080x1350), do NOT letterbox / pad / extend / outpaint. Fill the ENTIRE 4:5 frame — CSS overlay handles text; NO dark band or vignette. No visible text on any surface, no logos, no clearly identifiable faces (hands are fine).
note: Path B. All six pure editorial photos — no composites.

slides.imagePrompt: A single polished brass hotel room key on a small dark leather tag at the CENTER-LEFT of a walnut console table, in warm morning side-light (~8am). The key is machine-cut with visible use marks — small scratches along the bit end, natural patina on the brass shaft. The tag is unmarked blank leather (no readable number, no logo). RIGHT third breathes: the walnut console surface catching morning light, one small water ring near the far edge. Foreground: dark oak floorboards visible at the bottom edge with grain. Behind the console: warm-cream plaster wall (NEVER pastel, NEVER teal, NEVER sage). Hard warm-cool side-window key from left — brass catches a specular highlight along its bow, deep near-black shadow to the right of the tag. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no round white pots, no fresh flowers, no fiddle-leaf figs, no jute rug, no dated key rack, no service bell, no fountain pen, no paper ledger, no cash, no pastel wall, no styled 'hotel brochure' aesthetic. 4:5 native, no outpaint, fill entire frame. Editorial hotel still-life — the key is the subject, off-center, machine dignity applied to a hotel object.
slides.headline:
They didn't take ==18%==.
They took the ==guest==.
slides.sub: The commission is the line item you see. The guest you'll never re-book is the one you don't.

slides.imagePrompt: Overhead close of a single folded paper hotel receipt on a walnut console table, morning warm side-light. The receipt is folded once, revealing a single visible dollar-amount printed line (numbers non-readable but clearly a specific figure). ONE small circular hole has been punched THROUGH the receipt at the commission-line position, revealing walnut grain behind. A modern brushed-steel rollerball pen (NOT a fountain pen) rests diagonally beside the receipt, cap off, small ink mark on the barrel. Foreground: a coffee ring on the console. Hard morning side-window key from upper-left; specular highlight on the pen's steel; deep near-black shadow on the receipt's right fold. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no round white pots, no fresh flowers, no fountain pen, no paper ledger with quill, no service bell, no cash, no pastel wall, no styled 'hospitality' aesthetic. 4:5 native, no outpaint, fill entire frame. The punched hole is the point — the commission was extracted, physically.
slides.title: You saw ==the invoice==
slides.body: The line item on your P&L is the number they took. That number is finite and named. The name they took with them isn't on any invoice.

slides.imagePrompt: A close still-life of a single blank cream-colored index card resting OFF-CENTER LEFT on a linen sheet with visible natural wrinkles (NOT perfectly ironed). The card is unmarked — no text, no name, no fields filled, no logo. Behind the card, in soft focus at RIGHT: a hand-thrown ceramic bud vase holding a single real eucalyptus branch (leafy stem, NOT a fresh-cut flower, NOT in a clear glass vase). Foreground: linen texture with a slight cup-indentation from someone having placed a cup earlier. Hard morning warm-cool side-window key from upper-right; clear light on the card's top surface; deep near-black shadow to the card's left edge. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no round white pots, no fresh cut flowers in clear glass, no perfectly ironed sheets, no motivational text on card, no pastel wall, no symmetric composition. 4:5 native, no outpaint, fill entire frame. The card is empty of information — the point.
slides.title: You didn't see ==the profile==
slides.body: The OTA has their email, their preferences, the reason they booked. You have a room number and a night. Next year they get an OTA discount promo. You get a re-acquisition cost.

slides.imagePrompt: Close overhead of a physical guest-record index card at the LEFT third of a walnut console, FILLED with abstract non-readable handwritten notes in a modern rollerball pen (short horizontal lines, boxes, a small hand-drawn diagram — clearly worked-on, no readable words). A cracked-leather binder edge visible above the card. RIGHT third breathes: the walnut surface with a coffee ring and a small brass paper clip resting on it. Foreground: dark oak floorboards visible at the bottom edge. Hard morning warm-cool side-window key from left; deep near-black shadow on the card's right edge. PROHIBITED: no succulents, no round white pots, no fresh flowers, no fountain pen, no dated ledger with quill, no pastel wall, no styled 'hospitality' aesthetic. 4:5 native, no outpaint, fill entire frame. Editorial hotel: the filled card is a physical profile — knowledge as artifact.
slides.title: A direct booking is a ==profile==
slides.body: Name, email, the room they preferred, the wine they asked about. Not to spam them — to know them when they come back. Or to remind them to.
